profile.summary: raksbisht is a Mid-Level JavaScript developer with specialized expertise in Express.js backend development. Their contributions focus on incremental improvements—removing unused parameters, fixing typos, enhancing JSDoc, and refining utility functions. The developer demonstrates strong attention to code quality, documentation, and maintenance within the Express.js ecosystem, particularly in routing, middleware, and utility modules. While their contributions are primarily backend-focused and centered on JavaScript refactoring, they show a disciplined approach to maintaining clean, well-documented code. No evidence of frontend frameworks, TypeScript, or advanced async patterns is present in their contributions.
skill_evidence: Removed unused `originalIndex` parameter from `acceptParams` in Express routing logic (refactoring)
Added default value to `isAbsolute` function to prevent undefined errors (defensive programming)
Refactored `res.cookie` to handle `null/undefined` as `maxAge` (edge case safety)
Added JSDoc parameter descriptions for missing documentation (code clarity)
Labeled PRs with `tests` and `docs` indicating awareness of test and documentation standards
Closed PRs with minor semantic versioning changes (`6.x`, `semver-major` labels)
Focused on incremental improvements over large-scale feature development (maintenance mindset)
